plugin.name: SquareSoft_Chat_Router
plugin.author: OpenAI
plugin.purpose: Portable SquareSoft chat/tell capture rules for Generic_Chat_Miniwindow
plugin.description:
SQUARESOFT CHAT ROUTER v1.2
Owns the chat-routing triggers that Generic_Chat_Miniwindow intentionally does not define itself. Matching lines are removed from the raw server output and forwarded with their original MUD style runs to Generic_Chat_Miniwindow. Routed chat is always miniwindow-only: the original server line is omitted and the router uses Generic Chat's no-echo API so the catch cannot be duplicated in main output. The Generic Chat `chats echo` preference remains available for non-router callers.
Routed families: PartyTell, announce, newbie, gossip, death, auction, PlayerAuction You say, ... You tell NAME: ... NAME tells you: ... / NAME tells you, ...
Commands: chatrouter status chatrouter on chatrouter off
All trigger names are stable and live in group SS_CHAT_ROUTER.

muclient.script:
require "serialize"
CHAT_PLUGIN_ID = "10778718503f0c91106745f5" CHAT_TRIGGER_GROUP = "SS_CHAT_ROUTER" routerEnabled = GetVariable("router_enabled") ~= "false"
local function ChatAvailable() return IsPluginInstalled(CHAT_PLUGIN_ID) end
local function SetRouterEnabled(enabled) routerEnabled = enabled and true or false SetVariable("router_enabled", routerEnabled and "true" or "false") EnableGroup(CHAT_TRIGGER_GROUP, routerEnabled) end
-- Public API used by the suite installer during v1.x -> v2.0 migration. function SetPortableEnabled(value) local enabled = (value == true) or tostring(value or ""):lower() == "true" or tostring(value or "") == "1" if enabled and not ChatAvailable() then SetRouterEnabled(false) return "false" end SetRouterEnabled(enabled) return routerEnabled and "true" or "false" end
local function EchoStyles(styles, fallbackLine) if type(styles) == "table" and #styles > 0 then for _, style in ipairs(styles) do ColourTell( RGBColourToName(style.textcolour), RGBColourToName(style.backcolour), style.text or "" ) end Note("") else Note(fallbackLine or "") end end
function RouteChat(name, line, wildcards, styles) if not routerEnabled then return end
if not ChatAvailable() then -- Fail open: this line was omitted by the trigger, so put it back before -- disabling routing. Chat should never disappear because a dependency did. EchoStyles(styles, line) SetRouterEnabled(false) ColourNote("red", "", "[Chat Router] Generic_Chat_Miniwindow is missing; routing disabled.") ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Chat Router] Reinstall the suite, then type 'chatrouter on'.") return end
local rc = CallPlugin( CHAT_PLUGIN_ID, "display_noecho", serialize.save_simple(styles or {}) )
if rc ~= error_code.eOK then EchoStyles(styles, line) SetRouterEnabled(false) ColourNote("red", "", "[Chat Router] Could not forward chat (error " .. tostring(rc) .. "); routing disabled.") end end
function ChatRouterStatusAlias(name, line, wildcards) ColourNote("lime", "", "[Chat Router] " .. (routerEnabled and "ON" or "OFF")) ColourNote(ChatAvailable() and "gray" or "red", "", " Generic Chat destination: " .. (ChatAvailable() and "installed" or "MISSING")) end
function ChatRouterOnAlias(name, line, wildcards) if not ChatAvailable() then ColourNote("red", "", "[Chat Router] Generic_Chat_Miniwindow is not installed.") return end SetRouterEnabled(true) ColourNote("lime", "", "[Chat Router] enabled.") end
function ChatRouterOffAlias(name, line, wildcards) SetRouterEnabled(false) ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Chat Router] disabled.") end
function OnPluginInstall() if routerEnabled and not ChatAvailable() then SetRouterEnabled(false) ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Chat Router] Generic Chat is not installed; routing starts disabled.") else EnableGroup(CHAT_TRIGGER_GROUP, routerEnabled) end end
function OnPluginEnable() EnableGroup(CHAT_TRIGGER_GROUP, routerEnabled and ChatAvailable()) end
